endorsements.name: Jonatas Fil
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25356
endorsements.description: Bematech (formerly Logic Controls, now Elgin) MP-4200 TH printer contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the admin configuration page. Attackers can inject malicious scripts via crafted POST requests with malformed 'admin' and 'person' parameters, allowing execution of arbitrary JavaScript in the context of an authenticated user's browser session.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Jonatas Fil
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25401
endorsements.description: Bematech (formerly Logic Controls, now Elgin) MP-4200 TH printer contains a denial of service vulnerability in the admin configuration page. Remote attackers can send crafted POST requests with malformed 'admin' and 'person' parameters to crash the printer's web service, causing a denial of service condition.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)
